title: EnrichStatus
description: Read-only `enrich --status` report (no LLM, no singleton). v1.1.8 adds force_redescribe quality fields and blocked_dead state (GAP-CLI-ED-STATUS / OBS-04 / QISO).

status_report.description: Sentinel; always true for status reports.

unbound_backlog.description: Memory-bindings unbound backlog (legacy field; memory-bindings scoped).

scan_backlog.description: GAP-SG-77: per-operation database backlog the scan would enqueue.

scan_backlog_low_quality.description: v1.1.8: low-quality description backlog when --force-redescribe is active.

force_redescribe.description: v1.1.8: true when --force-redescribe was active for this status report.

quality_pct.description: v1.1.8 (OBS-04): fraction of sampled descriptions grounded against linked memory bodies.

quality_sample_n.description: v1.1.8: sample size used for quality_pct.

scan_backlog_low_grounding_est.description: v1.1.8: extrapolated count of low-grounding descriptions in the namespace.

state.description: Coarse backlog state: draining | cooldown | pending-scan | blocked_dead | empty. blocked_dead (v1.1.8 QISO) means scan deficit remains but only permanent dead queue rows remain.

waiting_items.description: Pending queue rows waiting on backoff cooldown.
